systems.system: Civil registration and vital statistics (CRVS) system
systems.platform: open source intended, product not named
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation, with municipalities as the registering bodies
systems.tiers: planned in January 2021: an automated electronic system with a national central database, administered by local governments and managed at state or municipality level, piloted in selected districts first; the policy states that no civil registration service had yet been launched by the government

systems.system: ICT equipment for municipal civil registrars' departments
systems.owner: Ministry of Interior, Federal Affairs and Reconciliation
systems.tiers: a priority action to 2025: equipment to be installed in selected maternal and child health centres and civil registrars' departments at the municipalities; no connection stated

note: A January 2021 policy that plans an electronic civil registration system run by municipalities and equipment for their registrars; it is a plan for an application and for equipment, and states nothing about any municipal office's connection.
